maya: Morning handoff — I'm out for PTO from 11:00 PT for ~6h. Leaving @devon as primary cover. Quick digest:

maya: What changed since last night:
- dataset-consumer (ingest pipeline) saw 3 transient failures between 02:10-04:30 UTC. All retries succeeded, no data loss observed.
- rolled a canary autoscaler tweak to reduce scaleDownGrace to 30s for low-traffic pools. Canary group: pool-canary-3.
- scheduled maintenance: Dedicated eu-west GPU cluster, 02:00-03:00 UTC tonight — should be non-disruptive but capacity may shift briefly.

maya: What to watch (priorities):
- ingestion-errors: if ERROR rate > 5% over 10m window, escalate. Check metric: inference.ingest.errors_pct.
- queue-lag: prefix queue > 500ms on dataset-consumer.
- autoscaler overshoot: rapid scale-downs causing warmup latency spikes (watch p90/p99 token latency).

maya: Short ops commands (if you need logs):
```
# tail errors for dataset-consumer last 2h
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=dataset-consumer --since=2h | grep ERROR
# check recent autoscaler events
kubectl -n infra get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=pool-canary-3 | tail -n 50
```

devon: got it. i'll put a synthetic job to exercise ingest every 15m for the next 6h and watch error_pct. :white_check_mark:

devon: linking the probe command i used: `scripts/synthetic_ingest/run_probe.sh --target dataset-consumer --count 10`

deploy-bot: Canary autoscaler patch deployed to pool-canary-3 at 4771230020 — rollout status: healthy. :rocket:

rui: heads up — PR #4124 (retry backoff fix for dataset-consumer) is queued and awaiting review. It's small, adds jitter to backoff.

sarah: i'll review PR #4124 now. if anything blocks i'll ping here. :eyes:

devon: one extra note — Dedicated eu-west maintenance may reduce burst capacity; if you see 5xx from the dedicated endpoint, fallback to hosted via routing policy `fallback: hosted-lowcost`.

maya: action items before i go:
- devon: start the synthetic probe job (15m cadence) and report any sustained >5% ERROR.
- sarah: quick review of #4124 and merge if green.
- rui: hold off on large deploys to eu-west after 01:30 UTC until maintenance completes.

devon: copy, probe is scheduled. i'll post a quick status in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sarah: Reviewing now, should be able to merge in next 10-20m.

ops-bot: Reminder — Scheduled maintenance for Dedicated eu-west cluster at 02:00 UTC (duration 1h). Disturbs: capacity shifts only. Link: <https://infra-status.example.com/maintenance/377>.

maya: thanks all. i'll check slack during break for any hard escalations but assume devon is primary. ping @devon for immediate stuff. :pray:
